name: IC — VSON
description: Surface-mount integrated circuit cluster in VSON package variants featuring 8-pin, 10-pin, and 14-pin footprints with exposed pads and optional thermal vias.
selection_hints: Verify exact pin count (8, 10, or 14 pin) and pitch (0.5mm or 0.65mm).
Match thermal pad dimensions and check whether thermal vias are required.
Prefer Tier A entries like TPS3430WDRC when fully verified parts are needed.
avoid_when: The target design requires through-hole mounting rather than SMD.
The required board footprint is outside the VSON package family.
A different pin count, pin pitch, or exposed thermal pad dimension is required.
